heads.t: 臉書小帳要掰了！12/14永久刪除「貼文、資料全消失」 5步驟快備份 臉書（Facebook）「其他個人檔案」功能即將走入歷史！該功能讓用戶能在主帳號下額外建立最多4個個人檔案，也就是俗稱的小帳，方便區隔不同生活圈，且不必登出就能自由切換。不過，Meta宣布，2026年12月14日起將終止這項功能，除了主帳號外，其他個人檔案都將遭到刪除，相關貼文、照片、好友及社團等資料也會永久消失，提醒用戶把握期限提前備份重要資訊。 17 分鐘前｜生活 臉書小帳要掰了！12/14永久刪除「貼文、資料全消失」 5步驟快備份 17 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: The Facebook account is about to break!12/14 permanently delete the "Pagebook, Disappear All" five-step backup Facebook "Other Personal Files" is about to enter history. This allows users to create up to four individual files under the main account, known as small accounts, easily separated from each other, and free to switch without posting. However, Meta has announced that it will end on December 14th, 2026, and that all personal files, except the main account, will be deleted, and that related messages, photos, friends and associations will be permanently eliminated, reminding users of the need to pre-empt critical information. 17 minutes ago, the Facebook account broke!
